about: Ruth is a story about love, kindness and a family God brings together.

pages.title: Ruth Stays
pages.scene: Ruth hugging Naomi on the road
pages.text: Naomi lost her husband and her sons. She decided to go home. Her son's wife Ruth said, "I will go with you. Your people will be my people, and your God will be my God." So Ruth and Naomi walked to Bethlehem together.
pages.lesson: Stay with the people you love.

pages.title: Ruth in the Field
pages.scene: Ruth picking up grain while Boaz watches
pages.text: Ruth worked hard picking up grain in a field. The owner, Boaz, saw her. He was kind and said, "Stay here. You can take all you need." He even left extra grain for her! Ruth took food home to Naomi.

pages.title: A New Family
pages.text: Boaz married Ruth. God gave them a baby boy named Obed. Naomi was so happy! She held the baby close. Many years later, Ruth's great-grandson David became the king.
